task.description:
WF-03 Step 04: Verify the ISS-0069 fix by re-running the onboarding E2E suite that originally failed. The fix rewrote navigateSpa in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts to use page.goto (commit 202d74da on feature/WF03-onboarding-e2e-fix-20260614). Run the SAME onboarding E2E suite from the ADHOC run that returned 2/2 BLOCKER failures:

1) Pre-checks (per CLAUDE.md TEST-RUNNER section):
   - docker-compose ps (keycloak, db must be healthy)
   - curl http://localhost:8081/health/ready (Keycloak)
   - psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c "SELECT 1" (test DB)
   - If any service down: STOP and return FAIL BLOCKER 'services unavailable' (ORCH will dispatch ADHOC BACKEND-DEV infra)

2) Run the onboarding E2E suite against the real backend (NO mocks — DIRECTIVE T-2):
   cd web
   npx playwright test onboarding/ --reporter=json > playwright-onboarding.json
   Also run the pipeline test:
   npx playwright test pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts --reporter=json > playwright-pipeline.json

3) Write report to tests/reports/report-2026-06-14-WF03-onboarding-e2e-fix-20260614-step-04.yaml per test guide §9 format.

PASS criteria: all onboarding E2E tests (onb-ui-01 through onb-ui-04 + onboarding-wizard pipeline) PASS. The original failures were navigation timeouts and role-guard assertion failures caused by the racy navigateSpa — those must now be resolved.

If tests FAIL: determine root cause; if still the same root cause, route to FRONTEND-DEV for rework via handoff issues. If a new failure, report it. Do NOT mask failures.
acceptance_criteria: All onb-ui-01 through onb-ui-04 E2E tests PASS
